items.reason: The override's early return bypasses busy-time checks, allowing slots that conflict with existing bookings or calendar events.

The comment explicitly identifies slots starting before the override start being accepted because they partially overlap. Requiring full containment fixes that lower-bound problem, along with the additional upper-bound case mentioned.
The working-hours check rejects a slot when any interval excludes it, making valid slots unavailable on split schedules.
The end boundary incorrectly uses slotStartTime, allowing events to extend beyond working hours.
Keeping only converted hours and minutes loses day rollover, producing reversed ranges for overrides that cross invitee midnight.
